tools.name: check_model
tools.description: Check whether an AI model identifier is deprecated, retiring, or has silently changed (price, context window, capabilities). Accepts any spelling a provider or SDK uses, e.g. 'gpt-4-turbo', 'azure/gpt-4.1-mini', 'claude-opus-4-1-20250805'. Call this before writing a model identifier into code.

tools.name: check_models
tools.description: Check many model identifiers at once and report which are retired or scheduled for retirement. Use when auditing a codebase or config.

tools.name: upcoming_retirements
tools.description: List models with an announced retirement date inside a horizon, soonest first.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Recent breaking changes across AI model APIs: price moves, context-window cuts, removed capabilities, removals. One entry per real upstream change.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "check_model" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
